honesty.note: Vector pack only. Numeric result fields are null until a sim/nmse/euler_*.json record exists per GF16_BFLOAT16_NMSE.md §5.

rng.name: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64)
rng.sampling_order: for i in 0..15: a_i = rng.standard_normal(8); b_i = rng.standard_normal(8)

distribution.name: standard_normal
distribution.rationale: Matches the existing tb_gf16_dot8.v pattern; isotropic, easy to reason about under NMSE.

canonical_anchor.name: dot4_canonical
canonical_anchor.comment: Bit-exact under FORMAT-SPEC-001 mapping; backed by sim/tb_gf16_dot8.v anchor row.

baseline_statement.gf16_reference: GF16 path is the existing src/gf16_dot4.v + src/gf16_dot8.v RTL driven via sim/tb_gf16_dot8.v.
baseline_statement.bfloat16_reference: Software round-trip: fp64 -> bfloat16 (round-to-nearest-even, no subnormal trap) -> multiply pairwise in bfloat16, accumulate in fp32, round final accumulator back to bfloat16 -> decode to fp64.
baseline_statement.fp64_oracle: y = sum_i (a_i_fp64 * b_i_fp64) computed in fp64.

tolerance.rationale: FP64 reference path is deterministic; cross-implementation drift below 1e-12 is below the noise floor of double-precision sums for N=8.

prohibited_promotions: Do not change seed_u32 without bumping vector_set_id and adding a row to docs/VERIFICATION_CLAIMS_MATRIX.md.
Do not write a number into nmse_mean/nmse_p99/nmse_db_mean in this file. Results live in sim/nmse/, not here.
Do not relabel tier to MEASURED unless silicon returns and the run is reproduced from the named seed.
